description: Use before starting agent work when you need a route-specific recent privacy-preserving signal for one routeType and targetClass. For the broad public aggregate feed use get_agent_traffic_feed; to submit an observed outcome use report_traffic_observation. Read-only; absence of a signal is not proof of health.

chain.description: Optional lowercase chain/network label such as base or tron when the route is chain-specific.

region.description: Optional two-letter uppercase country/region code for aggregate routing context.

targetClass.description: Type of technical target reached by the route.

windowMinutes.description: Lookback window in minutes, from 1 to 60. Omit to use the service default.

name: traffic_preflight
title: Agent Traffic Preflight
